title: Vidhwa Pension Yojana (Widow Pension)
content:
Scheme: Vidhwa Pension Yojana (Widow Pension) (विधवा पेंशन योजना)
State: Uttar Pradesh
Category: pension
Description: Monthly pension for widows from economically weaker sections in Uttar Pradesh.
Benefit: ₹1,000 / month
Eligibility: Applicant must be a widow. This scheme is only for residents of Uttar Pradesh. Annual family income must be below ₹2,00,000. Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Required documents: Husband's death certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना - ग्रामीण)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: housing
Description: Financial assistance for construction of pucca house for rural homeless / kutcha house families.
Benefit: ₹1,20,000 (plain areas) / ₹1,30,000 (hilly areas)
Eligibility: Annual household income must be below ₹3,00,000. Applicant should be from BPL / SECC-2011 deprived household list. Scheme prioritizes landless or kutcha-house households.
Required documents: SECC 2011 proof, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Land ownership / allotment document

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: financial-inclusion
Description: Zero-balance bank account with insurance and overdraft access for unbanked citizens.
Benefit: ₹2,00,000 accident insurance + ₹10,000 overdraft
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 10 years old. Aadhaar or valid ID proof required for account opening.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Passport size photo

title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
content:
Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: pension
Description: Monthly pension for senior citizens (60+) from Below Poverty Line households, under the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP). State governments usually add a top-up over the central amount.
Benefit: ₹200/month (age 60-79) or ₹500/month (age 80+) from the Centre, plus a state top-up that varies by state
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 60 years old. Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.
Required documents: Age proof, BPL / ration card, Aadhaar card, Bank or post office passbook

title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
content:
Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विकलांगता पेंशन योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: pension
Description: Monthly pension under NSAP for adults with severe disability (80% or more) from Below Poverty Line households.
Benefit: ₹300/month from the Centre, plus a state top-up that varies by state
Eligibility: Applicant must have a certified severe disability (80% or more). Applicant must be at least 18 years old. Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.
Required documents: Disability certificate, Age proof, BPL / ration card, Aadhaar card, Bank or post office passbook

title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
content:
Scheme: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi (पीएम-किसान सम्मान निधि)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: agriculture
Description: Income support for landholding farmer families, paid directly to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts in three instalments a year.
Benefit: ₹6,000/year (three instalments of ₹2,000 each)
Eligibility: Applicant's occupation must be recorded as farming. Applicant's family must own cultivable agricultural land in official state land records. Aadhaar-linked bank account is required to receive instalments.
Required documents: Land ownership records, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook

title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री उज्ज्वला योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: household
Description: Free LPG gas connection for adult women from poor households who don't already have one, to replace unsafe cooking fuels like wood and coal.
Benefit: Free LPG connection + free first refill and stove; ongoing subsidy of ₹300/cylinder (up to 9 cylinders/year)
Eligibility: Applicant must be a woman. Applicant must be at least 18 years old. Applicant's household must qualify as poor (BPL card, or another accepted deprivation category).
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Ration card / family composition document, Deprivation / BPL self-declaration, Bank passbook

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
content:
Scheme: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: health
Description: Cashless health insurance cover for hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals. Available to SECC-listed poor/vulnerable families, and separately to every citizen aged 70+ regardless of income (Ayushman Vay Vandana).
Benefit: ₹5,00,000 per family per year, cashless at empanelled hospitals
Eligibility: Citizens aged 70 and above qualify regardless of income under Ayushman Vay Vandana — this applicant's age doesn't meet that route.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Ration card, SECC / PMJAY family ID

title: Atal Pension Yojana
content:
Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (अटल पेंशन योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: pension
Description: Government-backed guaranteed pension scheme for workers in the unorganised sector, providing a fixed monthly pension after age 60 based on contributions made.
Benefit: ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 / month after age 60 (based on contribution)
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 18 years old. Applicant must be under 41 years old to join. Aadhaar-linked bank account is required.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Age proof

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षा बीमा योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: insurance
Description: Low-cost accidental death and disability insurance cover, renewable annually, for bank account holders.
Benefit: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death / full disability; ₹1,00,000 for partial disability
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 18 years old. Applicant must be under 71 years old. An active bank account linked to Aadhaar is required.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Bank passbook

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री जीवन ज्योति बीमा योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: insurance
Description: Renewable term life insurance scheme offering a lump sum to the nominee in case of the account holder's death, for a low annual premium.
Benefit: ₹2,00,000 life cover on death of the insured
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 18 years old. Applicant must be under 51 years old to newly enrol. An active bank account linked to Aadhaar is required.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Bank passbook

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: agriculture
Description: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss or damage from natural calamities, pests, or disease, at a heavily subsidised premium.
Benefit: Full sum insured on notified crop loss (premium as low as 1.5–5% of sum insured)
Eligibility: Applicant's occupation must be recorded as farming. Applicant must own or have tenancy rights over cultivable land.
Required documents: Land ownership / tenancy records, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री मातृ वंदना योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: health
Description: Maternity benefit cash incentive for pregnant and lactating women, to compensate for wage loss and encourage health-seeking behaviour around childbirth.
Benefit: ₹5,000 in instalments for the first live birth (additional ₹6,000 for second child if a girl, under PMMVY 2.0)
Eligibility: Applicant must be a woman. Applicant must be at least 18 years old. Aadhaar-linked bank account is required for disbursal.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Bank passbook

title: Janani Suraksha Yojana
content:
Scheme: Janani Suraksha Yojana (जननी सुरक्षा योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: health
Description: Cash assistance for institutional delivery to reduce maternal and infant mortality among poor and low-income pregnant women.
Benefit: ₹1,400 (rural) / ₹1,000 (urban) for institutional delivery, varies by state
Eligibility: Applicant must be a woman. Applicant's household should belong to a poor/BPL category (relaxed in low-performing states).
Required documents: Aadhaar card, BPL / ration card, Bank passbook

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना - शहरी)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: housing
Description: Affordable housing scheme for urban poor and middle-income households, offering interest subsidy on home loans or direct financial assistance for construction.
Benefit: Up to ₹2,67,000 interest subsidy (credit-linked) or direct assistance depending on income category
Eligibility: Annual household income must be below ₹18,00,000 (varies by income category). Applicant or family should not already own a pucca house anywhere in India.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Income certificate, Bank passbook

title: National Family Benefit Scheme
content:
Scheme: National Family Benefit Scheme (राष्ट्रीय परिवार लाभ योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: welfare
Description: One-time lump sum assistance to a Below Poverty Line household on the death of the primary breadwinner (aged 18–59), under the National Social Assistance Programme.
Benefit: ₹20,000 one-time lump sum
Eligibility: Applicant's household must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.
Required documents: Death certificate, BPL / ration card, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook

title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (प्रधानमंत्री श्रम योगी मानधन)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: pension
Description: Voluntary contributory pension scheme for unorganised sector workers, guaranteeing ₹3,000/month pension after age 60, with matching government contribution.
Benefit: ₹3,000/month pension after age 60
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 18 years old. Applicant must be under 41 years old to join. Monthly income should not exceed ₹15,000 (approx. ₹1,80,000/year). Aadhaar-linked bank account is required.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Bank passbook, Age proof

title: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री वय वंदना योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: pension
Description: Guaranteed pension scheme for senior citizens through a lump-sum investment with LIC, offering assured returns for 10 years. Note: closed for new subscriptions since 31 March 2023 — only existing policyholders can manage policies via LIC.
Benefit: Guaranteed pension of 7.4% p.a., payable monthly/quarterly/annually
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 60 years old.
Required documents: Age proof, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook

title: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana
content:
Scheme: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (राष्ट्रीय वयोश्री योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: welfare
Description: Provides free assistive devices (walking sticks, hearing aids, wheelchairs, spectacles, etc.) to senior citizens from BPL households.
Benefit: Free physical aids and assisted-living devices
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 60 years old. Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.
Required documents: Age proof, BPL / ration card, Medical assessment certificate

title: PM SVANidhi
content:
Scheme: PM SVANidhi (पीएम स्वनिधि)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: financial-inclusion
Description: Micro-credit facility for urban street vendors to resume livelihoods, offering small working-capital loans without collateral.
Benefit: ₹10,000 (1st loan), ₹20,000 (2nd), ₹50,000 (3rd) — collateral-free
Eligibility: Applicant must be a certified/identified urban street vendor. Aadhaar-linked bank account is required.
Required documents: Certificate of Vending / Vendor ID, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook

title: Stand Up India
content:
Scheme: Stand Up India (स्टैंड अप इंडिया)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: financial-inclusion
Description: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs setting up new greenfield enterprises.
Benefit: ₹10,00,000 to ₹1,00,00,000 bank loan
Eligibility: Scheme is open to women entrepreneurs, or SC/ST applicants. Scheme is open to SC/ST entrepreneurs, or women applicants.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Business project report, Caste certificate, Bank passbook

title: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: financial-inclusion
Description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh for non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises, categorised as Shishu, Kishor, Tarun, and Tarun Plus.
Benefit: Up to ₹20,00,000 collateral-free loan
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 18 years old. Aadhaar-linked bank account is required.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Business plan / project proposal, Bank passbook

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
content:
Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री कौशल विकास योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: skill-development
Description: Free short-term skill training and certification for youth, with placement assistance, under the flagship skilling scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development.
Benefit: Free skill training + certification (and monetary reward on certification for some cohorts)
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 15 years old. Applicant must generally be under 45 years old. Aadhaar is required for enrolment and certification.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Educational qualification certificate, Bank passbook

title: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
content:
Scheme: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण कौशल्य योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: skill-development
Description: Placement-linked skill training programme for rural poor youth, part of the National Rural Livelihood Mission.
Benefit: Free residential skill training + guaranteed placement assistance
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 15 years old. Applicant must be under 36 years old. Applicant must belong to a rural poor / BPL household.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, BPL / ration card, Bank passbook

title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
content:
Scheme: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: employment
Description: Legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
Benefit: 100 days/year guaranteed wage employment at notified minimum wage
Eligibility: Applicant must be at least 18 years old. Applicant's household must be in a rural area.
Required documents: Passport size photo, Aadhaar card, Residence proof

title: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
content:
Scheme: PM Vishwakarma Yojana (पीएम विश्वकर्मा योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: financial-inclusion
Description: Support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople (18 trades), offering skill upgradation, toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit.
Benefit: ₹15,000 toolkit incentive + collateral-free loans up to ₹3,00,000
Eligibility: Applicant must be engaged in one of the recognised traditional trades/crafts. Applicant must be at least 18 years old. Aadhaar-linked bank account is required.
Required documents: Aadhaar card, Proof of trade / craft, Bank passbook

title: Antyodaya Anna Yojana
content:
Scheme: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (अंत्योदय अन्न योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: household
Description: Highly subsidised foodgrain scheme for the poorest of the poor households under the Public Distribution System.
Benefit: 35 kg foodgrain/month at ₹2/kg (wheat) and ₹3/kg (rice)
Eligibility: Applicant's household must be identified as poorest-of-the-poor (AAY category) by the state.
Required documents: Ration card application / existing card, Aadhaar card, Income / poverty status document

title: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
content:
Scheme: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students (अनुसूचित जाति के लिए पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: education
Description: Financial assistance covering fees and maintenance allowance for SC students pursuing post-matriculation / post-secondary studies.
Benefit: Full course fee reimbursement + monthly maintenance allowance
Eligibility: Applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC). Parental/family annual income must be below ₹2,50,000.
Required documents: Caste certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Admission / bonafide certificate, Bank passbook

title: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
content:
Scheme: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students (अनुसूचित जनजाति के लिए प्री-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: education
Description: Scholarship support for ST students studying in classes 9 and 10, to reduce dropout at the secondary school stage.
Benefit: Annual scholarship for tuition, books, and maintenance allowance
Eligibility: Applicant must belong to a Scheduled Tribe (ST). Parental/family annual income must be below ₹2,50,000.
Required documents: Tribe certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, School enrolment certificate, Bank passbook

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
content:
Scheme: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना)
State: Central Government (all of India)
Category: financial-inclusion
Description: Small savings scheme for the parents/guardians of a girl child, offering a high fixed interest rate to build a corpus for her education and marriage expenses.
Benefit: High government-fixed interest rate (compounded annually) on deposits until maturity
Eligibility: Account can only be opened for a girl child. The girl child must be under 10 years old at the time of account opening.
Required documents: Birth certificate, Aadhaar card, Guardian's ID proof
